thread:
sara: Heads-up: onboarding sampleapp CI failing with Rust SDK but curl works. Seen during quickstart.

viv: what error?

sara: Rust client v0.1.2 call: 
```rust
client.routes.create(RouteCreate {
  name: "welcome".into(),
  traffic_percentage: 40,
  enable_experimental_cache: true,
});
```
SDK returns 404 "endpoint not found: /v1/routes". curl to /v1/routes succeeds (201).

ken: odd. our Rust SDK was implemented early and only covered a subset of endpoints (chat, embeddings). looks like routes endpoints never got wired up.

morgan: also noticed param-casing drift: the Rust struct uses snake_case but our JSON marshaller converts field names to camelCase for consistency with serde default? That mismap caused earlier failures in other SDKs.

viv: and another thing: when auth refresh happens mid-request the SDK retries the POST without idempotency key and duplicates appear in Dedicated tests. curl doesn't retry so no dupes.

sara: big onboarding friction. new users hit this in first run.

infra-bot: Created RDW-1401: "rust-sdk missing endpoints + param-casing drift + unsafe retry for mutating ops" https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RDW-1401 :white_check_mark:

ken: plan: 1) wire up missing routes endpoints in Rust SDK, 2) pin serde tags to server snake_case explicitly, 3) add pass-through for unknown fields and emit a warning, 4) generate Idempotency-Key for mutating calls or avoid retrying POSTs when no key.

morgan: i'll own idempotency change and a CI test that triggers a 401 mid-request to assert no duplicates. viv can own bindings and serde tags.

viv: will open a small PR to add endpoints and update tests. also add a quickstart note about SDK coverage until patch ships.

sara: thanks team 1: catching this early saves demos. :thumbsup:
